acme robotics.name: Acme Robotics
acme robotics.summary: Builds autonomous mobile robots that pick and move inventory in warehouses, sold as a monthly subscription.

news.title: Acme Robotics signs 40 site deal with Pacific Grocers
news.summary: A three year deployment across Pacific Grocers' West Coast distribution centers, Acme's largest contract to date.

news.title: OSHA cites Acme Robotics customer site over robot aisle injury
news.summary: OSHA proposed a $41,000 penalty after a worker was struck in a shared robot aisle at a customer warehouse in Reno.

news.title: Acme Robotics takes $30M in venture debt to fund fleet expansion
news.summary: The debt facility from Bay Harbor Credit funds robots leased to customers rather than new equity.

news.title: Acme Robotics lays off 8 percent of staff
news.summary: About 40 roles cut, mostly in sales and a paused European expansion; the company said it is focusing on US grocery.

news.title: Kinetix Automation sues Acme Robotics over picking arm patent
news.summary: Kinetix alleges Acme's gripper infringes two patents; Acme called the suit meritless.

litigation.parties: Kinetix Automation, Inc. v. Acme Robotics, Inc.
litigation.status: Pending; claim construction hearing set for 2026-12-03
litigation.summary: Alleges the Acme Grip 3 end effector infringes U.S. Patents 11,204,553 and 11,488,120.

litigation.court: Superior Court of California, Alameda County
litigation.parties: Lopez et al. v. Acme Robotics, Inc.
litigation.summary: Former employees claim the March 2026 layoff lacked required 60 day notice.

filings.summary: Notice of exempt offering: $120M Series C equity.
One serious citation at a customer site in Reno, NV (inspection 1789234); $41,000 proposed, contested.
Grant for the AR-7 robot's 5 GHz radio module.
Lists Priya Raman as CFO and a new principal address in Oakland.

globex logistics.name: Globex Logistics
globex logistics.summary: A digital freight broker matching shippers with carriers.
